NTRO acquires TIER IV autonomous bus for Australian transit trials

The 15-seat electric Rita bus has been tuned on a test track ahead of demonstrations and service trials.

TIER IV ↗29 October 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 2

From partnership to vehicle

Australia’s NTRO has purchased a 15-seat electric bus with TIER IV’s automated driving system, following their 2024 collaboration. The vehicle is named Rita after Rita Excell, who helped establish an Australian autonomous-vehicle trial in 2015.

Local testing and demonstrations

The partners tested and tuned the bus on a dedicated track for driverless demonstrations and conditional automation with a driver present. NTRO is offering transport agencies, operators, councils and airports in Australia and New Zealand demonstrations and service trials, including on public roads.

Trials are not a nationwide service

The initiative targets short local trips and driver shortages, but names no permanent commercial route or launch date. Procurement and trials do not establish unrestricted driverless operation. Statements about lower costs and environmental benefits remain the project operators’ expectations.
